section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the development and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version (BAS-2) across different cultures. The present study aims to examine the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran (Study 1), a non-Western culture increasingly influenced by Westernized media. The study hypothesizes that BAS-2 scores will be positively correlated with self-esteem and life satisfaction, and negatively correlated with BMI, with expected sex differences favoring men.
